method: Read the exact frozen source bytes, not a current checkout or translated paraphrase.
Compare each suspect expression with the immediately controlling formula, table, definition, proof variable scope, or displayed construction.
Classify only deterministic defects whose intended reading is fixed by that context.
Require every translation lane to preserve the frozen source identity, repair the translated body, and add an adjacent keyed note plus a machine-readable correction record.

findings.finding: The header and formula rows include f(7), whose value is -3, but the final value row stops at 3 and omits -3.
findings.controlling_evidence: At f(7), the preceding formula row is -ceil(6/2), hence -3.
findings.required_translation_handling: Add -3 in the value row and an adjacent OLSIZ-001 source-correction note.

findings.finding: The phrase 'complement of a finite set Nat' is malformed and omits the relation between the finite set and Nat.
findings.controlling_evidence: The following equivalence says A is cofinite iff Nat\setminus A is finite.
findings.required_translation_handling: State 'the complement in Nat of a finite subset of Nat' (or an exact language-equivalent) and add an adjacent OLSIZ-002 note.

findings.finding: The prose repeats the family (2,m) where it is enumerating successive rows.
findings.controlling_evidence: The immediately following table contains rows/families (2,m), (3,m), and onward; the second prose occurrence must be (3,m).
findings.required_translation_handling: Replace the second (2,m) by (3,m) and add an adjacent OLSIZ-003 note.

findings.finding: The definition calls f(Z) the sequence s_k although k is never bound or determined.
findings.controlling_evidence: The component equation uniquely defines the characteristic sequence of Z, and the surjectivity argument later denotes an arbitrary output sequence by s.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use one bound output name, such as s, consistently in the characteristic-sequence definition and add an adjacent OLSIZ-004 note.

findings.finding: The displayed h(n) is explicitly a finite string of n zeros, but h is declared to map into the set of infinite binary sequences.
findings.controlling_evidence: Membership in Bin^omega requires an infinite binary sequence; appending an infinite tail, for example n zeros followed by ones forever, supplies the intended non-surjective example.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use a valid infinite binary output and add an adjacent OLSIZ-005 note.

findings.finding: Two conditional variants refer to g(x)=y before g is introduced, although the bijection in scope is f.
findings.controlling_evidence: The proof has fixed f:A to B; g is introduced only later as an enumeration of A.
findings.required_translation_handling: Replace both premature g(x)=y occurrences by f(x)=y and add an adjacent OLSIZ-006 note.

findings.finding: After choosing arbitrary x in A, the source says the conclusion holds for each x in overline(A).
findings.controlling_evidence: To prove the diagonal set is outside the range, the argument needs g(x) different from overline(A) for every x in A; both preceding cases concern arbitrary x in A.
findings.required_translation_handling: Quantify the conclusion over x in A and add an adjacent OLSIZ-007 note.

findings.finding: The prose calls s_n(m) the nth digit of the mth string, reversing the indices.
findings.controlling_evidence: The next sentence and array place s_n(m) in row n and column m, so it is the mth digit of the nth string.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use the row/column-consistent description and add an adjacent OLSIZ-008 note.

findings.finding: The intuitive diagonal instruction says to change every 1 to 0 twice.
findings.controlling_evidence: The immediately following cases define complementary flips: diagonal 1 becomes 0 and diagonal 0 becomes 1.
findings.required_translation_handling: State both complementary bit flips and add an adjacent OLSIZ-009 note.

findings.finding: The alternate proof again calls f(N) the string s_k although k is never bound or determined.
findings.controlling_evidence: The component equation uniquely defines the characteristic sequence of N.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use one bound output name consistently and add an adjacent OLSIZ-010 note.
